name: clawsec
title_zh: SOUL.md 一被改动就报警的看门狗套件
tagline_zh: 装一次，四款 Agent 的 SOUL.md 全在盯：漂移检测、安全建议、自动审计、技能完整性校验，全自动巡夜。
tagline_en: One install, four agents' SOUL.md guarded: drift detection, live security tips, auto-audits, integrity checks—all.
desc_en: A complete security skill suite for OpenClaw, Hermes, PicoClaw and NanoClaw agents (and variants). Protect your SOUL.md (etc') with drift detection, live security recommendations, automated audits, and skill integrity verification. All from one installable suite.
why_zh: 不是单点补丁，是一整套安全闭环：检测到漂移当场给建议，审计自动跑，技能完整性独立验证。
why_en: Not a patch—a closed loop: drift triggers live advice, audits run themselves, skill integrity checked independently, covers four.
limit_zh: 只护 SOUL.md 及同类核心指令文件，不碰工具权限、API 密钥泄露或运行时沙箱。
limit_en: Guards SOUL.md & similar core instruction files only—not tool perms, API leaks, or sandboxing. Needs OpenClaw/Hermes/PicoClaw/NanoClaw env; inert on.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Watchdog suite that alerts the moment SOUL.md drifts
